headline: WESTHAVEN DRILLS 27.51m AT 14.47 g/t Au IN SOUTHERN BC — Fifth Rig Now Targeting Growth Beyond 35,000m South Zone Infill (TSXV: WVN)
snippet: Westhaven Gold Corp. (TSXV: WVN) released the fourth batch of assays from its 35,000-metre South Zone infill program at the Shovelnose Gold Property in southern British Columbia on July 28, confirming continuity of high-grade mineralization in both Vein Zone 1 and Vein Zone 2 — with the headline intercept returning 27.51 metres grading 14.47 g/t gold and 52 g/t silver. A fifth drill rig has been mobilized under a separate 15,000-metre exploration program targeting resource growth outside the current resource envelope.

headline: XALI GOLD MAPS 1.35km × 0.83km EPITHERMAL FOOTPRINT IN CENTRAL PERU — 31.5m @ 2.92 g/t Au Including 4.5m @ 13.76 g/t Au at Pico Machay (TSXV: XGC)
snippet: Xali Gold Corp. (TSXV: XGC) released initial underground and surface channel sampling results from the Pico Machay Gold Project in Peru's Southern Epithermal Belt on July 28, confirming high-sulphidation epithermal gold mineralization across a 1.35-kilometre by 0.83-kilometre footprint — with 67 of 119 surface samples above 0.50 g/t gold and a standout channel intercept of 31.5 metres at 2.92 g/t gold including 4.5 metres at 13.76 g/t gold. The scale of the system and consistent surface gold endowment indicate a bulk-tonnage epithermal target at a project stage where most peers are still doing geophysics.

headline: IMPLATS HALTS ALL RUSTENBURG OPERATIONS AFTER SIX DEATHS — 51,500-Person PGM Mine Accounts for Half of Group Output; Safety Reset Underway
snippet: Impala Platinum (Implats) suspended all production at its Rustenburg operations in South Africa for a safety reset after six worker fatalities in fiscal 2026 — four during the year to June 30 and two additional underground deaths in July involving fatal locomotive accidents — with independent specialists appointed to assess safety systems. Rustenburg employs approximately 51,500 people and accounts for nearly half of Implats' total platinum group metals output, making the suspension material for PGM supply; the four-day reset covers workplace inspections, targeted training, and employee engagement across the complex.

headline: FURY GOLD RESUMES EAU CLAIRE DRILLING AFTER 12-DAY WILDFIRE EVACUATION — Phase 2 Program Back On, No Material Delay, Northern Quebec (TSXV: FURY)
snippet: Fury Gold Mines (TSXV: FURY) confirmed July 27 that all personnel have returned to the Eau Claire Gold Project in Quebec's James Bay region after a precautionary wildfire evacuation that began July 15 forced a 12-day suspension of Phase 2 drilling. Authorities confirmed safe conditions and the company reported no material impact on its previously disclosed 2026 drill program.

headline: HOMELAND URANIUM FULLY PERMITTED FOR INAUGURAL COLORADO DRILL — BLM and State Clear 30 Holes at Cross Bones; Phase I Begins Fall 2026 (TSXV: HLU)
snippet: Homeland Uranium Corp. (TSXV: HLU) received drilling approvals from the U.S. Bureau of Land Management and Colorado Division of Reclamation, Mining and Safety on July 27 for up to 30 diamond drill holes at its Cross Bones Uranium Project in Moffat and Rio Blanco Counties, Colorado — permits valid through June 2028. Phase I will twin historical holes drilled by Anschutz Uranium Corp. in 1977-78, with drilling scheduled to commence fall 2026; this is the project's first-ever drill program.

headline: GT RESOURCES LOCKS UP 10-YEAR YUKON PERMIT FOR 1.95% Ni COPPER-NICKEL TARGET — Road Access Expanded for Deeper Canalask Drilling (TSXV: GT)
snippet: GT Resources (TSXV: GT) received a 10-year Class III Exploration Permit for the Canalask Copper-Nickel Project in Yukon on July 27, a road-accessible property where 2024 drilling returned 1.95% Ni, 0.05% Cu, 0.03% Co, 0.19 g/t Au, and 0.44 g/t Pd over 33.5 metres near surface in the Footwall Zone. Critically, the new permit allows construction of additional trails for expanded drilling access, opening multiple new targets for systematic follow-up.

headline: SCORPIO GOLD PURSUES NASDAQ ADS LISTING AFTER $10.8M RAISE — F-10 Filed With SEC; Walker Lane Nevada Assets to Get U.S. Market Access (TSXV: SGN)
snippet: Scorpio Gold Corp. (TSXV: SGN) announced July 27 it intends to list American Depositary Shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market, with each ADS expected to represent approximately 20 common shares, filing a Form F-10 with the SEC and a short-form shelf prospectus in Canada. The announcement follows the company's July 23 close of a $10.8-million offering at $0.25 per share — proceeds earmarked for exploration at the Manhattan Property in Nevada's Walker Lane Trend, where Scorpio holds 4,780 hectares including the Goldwedge Mine with a 400-tonne-per-day gravity mill.

headline: SELKIRK COPPER BEGINS OTCQX TRADING AS MINTO MINE FEASIBILITY CLOSES IN — Yukon Cu-Au Restart Targets 2028; MRE and PEA Due Now (TSXV: SCMI)
snippet: Selkirk Copper Mines (TSXV: SCMI / OTCQX: SKRKF) began trading on the OTCQX Best Market on July 28, improving U.S. investor access as the company moves toward key technical milestones at the Minto copper-gold-silver mine in Yukon — Canada's only operating copper mine north of 62° N before it was suspended. A Phase 2 drill program has been underway since May 2026, an updated mineral resource estimate and preliminary economic assessment are due for completion this month, and a feasibility study is planned for Q3 2026, with a production restart targeted for mid-2028.

headline: GROUP ELEVEN DRILLS 550m STEP-OUT WITH 2.8m @ 21.7% Zn+Pb BONANZA — Most Significant Stonepark Result Since 2017 Opens New Irish Zinc Corridor (TSXV: ZNG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Group Eleven Resources
snippet: Group Eleven Resources (TSXV: ZNG) drilled massive to semi-massive zinc-lead sulphide 550 metres beyond the edge of its Stonepark Mineral Resource Estimate in Ireland — hole 26-2638-07 returned 14.7 metres at 2.0% Zn+Pb including 2.8 metres at 8.3% Zn+Pb, with 1.0 metre of 21.7% Zn+Pb and 4 g/t silver at 461-metre depth — the most significant Stonepark result since Group Eleven assumed operatorship in 2017. The company is considering a follow-up campaign of approximately 12,800 metres in late 2026 or early 2027 to define the extent of the newly discovered zone.

headline: TOCVAN HITS 581 g/t Ag AT SURFACE 900m FROM HEAP-LEACH SITE — New Zone Expands Mexico Silver-Gold Project; First Doré Pour Targeted Q4 2026 (CSE: TOC)
snippet: Tocvan Ventures (CSE: TOC) discovered a new at-surface silver-gold zone 900 metres east of its planned 50,000-tonne heap-leach Pilot Facility at the Gran Pilar Project in Sonora, Mexico — standout hole JES-26-152 returning 1.5 metres at 581 g/t silver and 2.2 g/t gold within a broader 9.2-metre interval at 110 g/t silver and 0.4 g/t gold. The company holds a 10-year pilot mine permit (secured August 2025), a 6-year community agreement (signed May 2026), and is under construction with a first gold-silver doré pour targeted for Q4 2026.
